chunks.ar: حصل ناسك على بقرة حلوب، وقادها إلى بيته في المساء.
chunks.en_old: An ascetic received a milking cow and led it home in the evening.
chunks.en_new: An ascetic received a milking cow and led it home in the evening.

chunks.ar: كان يتخيل كيف سيشرب من لبنها كل يوم.
chunks.en_old: He imagined drinking its milk every day.
chunks.en_new: He imagined drinking its milk every day.

chunks.ar: لكن لصًا رآه في الطريق
chunks.en_old: But a thief saw him on the road
chunks.en_new: But a thief saw him on the road

chunks.ar: وقرر أن يتبعه ليسرق البقرة عندما ينام.
chunks.en_old: and decided to follow him and steal the cow after he fell asleep.
chunks.en_new: and decided to follow him and steal the cow after he fell asleep.

chunks.ar: في الوقت نفسه، كان شيطان يتبع الناسك أيضًا.
chunks.en_old: At the same time a devil was also following the ascetic.
chunks.en_new: At the same time a devil was also following the ascetic.

chunks.ar: لم يكن يريد البقرة، بل أراد أن يخطف الرجل وهو نائم.
chunks.en_old: He did not want the cow; he intended to abduct the sleeping man.
chunks.en_new: He did not want the cow; he intended to abduct the sleeping man.

chunks.ar: التقى الشيطان باللص قرب البيت،
chunks.en_old: The devil met the thief near the house,
chunks.en_new: The devil met the thief near the house,

chunks.ar: وسأله كل واحد منهما عن سبب وجوده.
chunks.en_old: and each asked the other why he was there.
chunks.en_new: and each asked the other why he was there.

chunks.ar: قال اللص: «سآخذ البقرة عندما ينام صاحبها.»
chunks.en_old: “I will take the cow after her owner sleeps,” said the thief.
chunks.en_new: “I will take the cow after her owner sleeps,” said the thief.

chunks.ar: وقال الشيطان: «وأنا سأخطف الرجل نفسه.»
chunks.en_old: “And I will take the man himself,” said the devil.
chunks.en_new: “And I will take the man himself,” said the devil.

chunks.ar: رأى الاثنان أن الوقت مناسب،
chunks.en_old: Both thought the moment was right,
chunks.en_new: Both thought the moment was right,

chunks.ar: فاتفقا على الانتظار حتى يطفئ الناسك المصباح ويستريح.
chunks.en_old: so they agreed to wait until the ascetic put out the lamp and rested.
chunks.en_new: so they agreed to wait until the ascetic put out the lamp and rested.

chunks.ar: دخل الناسك بيته، وربط البقرة في زاوية،
chunks.en_old: The ascetic went inside, tied the cow in a corner,
chunks.en_new: The ascetic went inside, tied the cow in a corner,

chunks.ar: وتناول عشاءه ثم نام.
chunks.en_old: ate his supper, and fell asleep.
chunks.en_new: ate his supper, and fell asleep.

chunks.ar: تسلل اللص والشيطان إلى الداخل.
chunks.en_old: The thief and the devil slipped in.
chunks.en_new: The thief and the devil slipped in.

chunks.ar: لكن قبل أن يتحرك أحدهما، بدأ بينهما خلاف حول من يبدأ أولًا.
chunks.en_old: But before either moved, they began arguing over who should go first.
chunks.en_new: But before either moved, they began arguing over who should go first.

chunks.ar: قال الشيطان: «دعني أخطف الرجل أولًا.
chunks.en_old: The devil said, “Let me take the man first.
chunks.en_new: The devil said, “Let me take the man first.

chunks.ar: إن أخذت البقرة قبلي فقد تستيقظ وتصدر صوتًا،
chunks.en_old: If you take the cow before me, she may wake up and make a noise.
chunks.en_new: If you take the cow before me, she may wake up and make a noise.

chunks.ar: فينهض الناسك ولا أستطيع أخذه.»
chunks.en_old: Then the ascetic will rise, and I cannot take him.”
chunks.en_new: Then the ascetic will rise, and I cannot take him.”

chunks.ar: لكن اللص رفض أن ينتظر.
chunks.en_old: But the thief refused to wait.
chunks.en_new: But the thief refused to wait.

chunks.ar: رد اللص: «بل دعني أسرق البقرة أولًا!
chunks.en_old: The thief replied, “No, let me steal the cow first!
chunks.en_new: The thief replied, “No, let me steal the cow first!

chunks.ar: إذا حاولت خطف الرجل فربما يستيقظ،
chunks.en_old: If you try to abduct the man, he may wake up.
chunks.en_new: If you try to abduct the man, he may wake up.

chunks.ar: وعندها لن أستطيع الخروج بالبقرة.»
chunks.en_old: Then I cannot leave with the cow.”
chunks.en_new: Then I cannot leave with the cow.”

chunks.ar: ارتفع صوتاهما شيئًا فشيئًا، ولم يرضَ أي منهما بالتراجع.
chunks.en_old: Their voices grew louder, and neither would give way.
chunks.en_new: Their voices grew louder, and neither would give way.

chunks.ar: وفجأة صرخ اللص: «أيها الناسك، استيقظ!
chunks.en_old: Suddenly the thief shouted, “Ascetic, wake up!
chunks.en_new: Suddenly the thief shouted, “Ascetic, wake up!

chunks.ar: هناك شيطان يريد خطفك!»
chunks.en_old: A devil wants to abduct you!”
chunks.en_new: A devil wants to abduct you!”

chunks.ar: فصرخ الشيطان أيضًا: «استيقظ! هذا لص يريد سرقة بقرتك!»
chunks.en_old: The devil shouted too, “Wake up! This is a thief trying to steal your cow!”
chunks.en_new: The devil shouted too, “Wake up! This is a thief trying to steal your cow!”

chunks.ar: سمع الناسك الصياح، ففتح عينيه ونهض بسرعة.
chunks.en_old: The ascetic heard the yelling, opened his eyes, and jumped up.
chunks.en_new: The ascetic heard the yelling, opened his eyes, and jumped up.

chunks.ar: جاء الجيران بعدما سمعوا الضجة،
chunks.en_old: The neighbors came when they heard the commotion,
chunks.en_new: The neighbors came when they heard the commotion,

chunks.ar: فهرب اللص والشيطان دون أن يأخذا شيئًا.
chunks.en_old: and the thief and the devil fled empty-handed.
chunks.en_new: and the thief and the devil fled empty-handed.

chunks.ar: بقي الناسك في بيته وبقرته إلى جانبه.
chunks.en_old: The ascetic stayed in his home with his cow beside him.
chunks.en_new: The ascetic stayed in his home with his cow beside him.

chunks.ar: كان الاثنان قد اقتربا من النجاح، لكن خلافهما أنقذ الرجل.
chunks.en_old: Both intruders had been close to success, but their quarrel saved the man.
chunks.en_new: Both intruders had been close to success, but their quarrel saved the man.
